meta.name: azure-cost
meta.description: Azure cost management: query costs, forecast spending, optimize to reduce waste. WHEN: "Azure costs", "Azure bill", "cost breakdown", "how much am I spending", "forecast spending", "optimize costs", "reduce spending", "orphaned resources", "rightsize VMs", "cost spike", "reduce storage costs", "AKS cost". DO NOT USE FOR: deploying resources, provisioning, diagnostics, or security audits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询并优化 Azure 云支出，降低浪费
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常为 Azure 账单过高而烦恼
copy.tagline_en: Query and optimize Azure cloud spend, reduce waste
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about high Azure bills

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查询历史 Azure 花费、预测未来支出,并给出减少浪费的优化方向;查询可限定在订阅、资源组等范围内进行。
howto.when: 当你提到 “Azure costs”、“cost breakdown”、“forecast spending” 等关键词,或想降低 Azure 支出时触发。不用于部署资源、预配、诊断或安全审计。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个订阅上个月的 Azure 花费明细
say.note: 按指定范围查询历史成本

say.text: 预测一下我下个月的 Azure 支出
say.note: 调用预测接口给出未来花费估算

say.text: 找出闲置资源,把 VM 规格调小来降低花销
say.note: 进入成本优化流程,列出可省项

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can query historical Azure costs, forecast future spending, and point out optimizations that cut waste. Queries can be scoped to a subscription, resource group, and similar scopes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "Azure costs", "cost breakdown", "forecast spending" and similar terms, or want to cut spending. Not for deploying resources, provisioning, diagnostics, or security audits.

say_en.text: Show me last month's Azure cost breakdown for this subscription
say_en.note: Queries historical costs within the chosen scope

say_en.text: Forecast my Azure spending for next month
Find orphaned resources and rightsize VMs to cut costs
